scope: Static algorithm and convergence design review; no product edits or new performance samples.

findings.preflight_guard: KisPageMutationExecution::prepareWrites calls beginWriteImpl(preparationOnly=true) then resets the public guard; reset unpins and records Exposed -> Prepared.
findings.input_capability: InputBytesReady does not promise no further mutation; inputKind is currently MutableGuard or Semantic.
findings.phase_identity: Entry Prepared and metadata Prepared have distinct meanings; alias and candidate final path infer phase from writable reservation absence.
findings.late_failure: Fresh independent pixels remain discardable; live-backing first mutation has a stricter irreversibility boundary.
findings.business_causality: Previous freehand CPU regression does not identify ordinary guard/wrapper/layout causality; actual F/P/A by stage remains unmeasured.
